**Notes**

* Add some notes here
* Use markdown

STRING : 

SET key value — stores a string value at a key, overwriting if it exists.

GET key — retrieves the string value stored at a key.

APPEND key value — adds the given value to the end of an existing string (creates the key if it doesn't exist).

LIST: 
RPUSH key val1 val2 ... — pushes values onto the right (tail) end of a list.

LINDEX key index — returns the element at a given index (0-based).

LLEN key — returns the number of elements in the list.

LINSERT key BEFORE|AFTER pivot value — inserts a value immediately before/after a pivot element already in the list.

LRANGE key start stop — returns a range of elements (0 -1 means "all").

HAASH:
HSET key field value [field value ...] — sets one or more field-value pairs on a hash.

HGET key field — gets the value of a single field.

HDEL key field — removes a field from the hash.

HGETALL key — returns all fields and values in the hash.

SET:
SADD key member1 member2 ... — adds one or more unique members to a set.

SCARD key — returns the number of members (cardinality) of a set.

SDIFF key1 key2 — returns members present in the first set but not in the others.

SORTED SET:
ZADD key score member [score member ...] — adds members with an associated score, kept ordered by score.

ZDIFF numkeys key1 key2 — returns members in the first sorted set not present in the others (numkeys tells Redis how many keys follow).

ZCOUNT key min max — counts members whose score falls within a given range.

BITMAP (bitmaps are really just 
Strings addressed at the bit level)

SETBIT key offset value — sets the bit at a given offset to 0 or 1.

BITOP AND|OR|XOR|NOT destkey key1 key2 — performs a bitwise operation across keys and stores the result.

BITCOUNT key — counts the number of bits set to 1.

BITPOS key bit — finds the position of the first bit set to the given value (0 or 1).

HyperLogLog:

PFADD key element1 element2 ... — adds elements to a probabilistic set used for cardinality estimation.

PFCOUNT key — returns the approximate number of unique elements added.

PFMERGE destkey key1 key2 — merges multiple HyperLogLogs into one, combining their estimated counts.

JSON (RedisJSON)

JSON.SET key path value — sets a JSON value at a given path ($ means the root).

JSON.GET key path — retrieves the JSON value at a given path.

JSON.DEL key path — deletes the value at a given path within the JSON document.

Search Index (RediSearch module):

FT.CREATE index ON JSON|HASH PREFIX n prefix SCHEMA field AS alias TYPE ... — defines a searchable index over keys matching a prefix, mapping JSON/hash fields to typed, queryable fields (TEXT, TAG, NUMERIC, etc.).

FT.SEARCH index query — runs a full-text/filter query against the index and returns matching documents.

FT.PROFILE index SEARCH QUERY query — runs a query while returning a breakdown of execution time and steps, for debugging performance.

FT.CREATE idx:candidates ON JSON PREFIX 1 candidate: 
  SCHEMA $.name AS name TEXT $.skills[*] AS skills TAG $.experience AS experience NUMERIC
